name: session-handoff
description: Writes a handoff file for the current session automatically on /handoff-session, shortly before the prompt cache goes cold, and when the context grows past a token threshold.

cache_minutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cache_minutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a turn.

lead_minutes.title: Lead time (minutes)
lead_minutes.description: The cache handoff runs this many minutes before the cache goes cold.

context_tokens.title: Context threshold (tokens)
context_tokens.description: The context handoff fires once the context passes this many tokens.
